name: Spinach & feta omelet
description: A quick, fluffy omelet filled with greens and salty feta.
steps: Whisk eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Wilt spinach in a lightly oiled pan.
Pour in eggs, cook gently, and scatter over feta.
Fold the omelet and serve warm.

name: Creamy lemon yogurt pasta
description: Bright lemon and tangy yogurt make a silky, easy pasta sauce.
steps: Cook pasta in salted water until al dente; reserve a mug of pasta water.
Stir yogurt with lemon zest and juice.
Toss the hot pasta with the yogurt mixture and a splash of pasta water.
Finish with crumbled feta and black pepper.

name: Tomato & spinach skillet pasta
description: A cozy one-pan style pasta with juicy tomatoes and tender greens.
steps: Cook pasta and reserve a little cooking water.
Chop tomatoes and cook in a pan until saucy.
Stir in spinach until wilted, then add pasta.
Finish with lemon juice and a splash of pasta water.

name: Avocado yogurt toast
description: Creamy avocado, a tangy yogurt drizzle, and bright lemon on toast.
steps: Toast your favorite bread.
Mash avocado with a squeeze of lemon, salt, and pepper.
Spread over toast and finish with a spoonful of yogurt.

name: Tomato & feta salad
description: A fresh, savory salad with crunchy greens and a lemony finish.
steps: Slice tomatoes and roughly chop spinach.
Crumble feta over the vegetables.
Dress with lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper.

name: Green spinach yogurt bowl
description: A cool, savory bowl with lemon, herbs, and creamy yogurt.
steps: Whisk yogurt with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Chop spinach and avocado.
Layer in a bowl and drizzle with the lemon yogurt.

name: Tomato & egg skillet
description: Eggs gently cooked in a quick tomato pan sauce with greens.
steps: Chop and simmer tomatoes in an oiled skillet until soft.
Stir in spinach until just wilted.
Make small wells, crack in eggs, cover, and cook until set.
Top with feta and serve.
